"Celeste and Luna: Hentai Puzzle 18+" is a puzzle game where players assemble images of girls by rotating puzzle pieces. Once completed, the puzzle appears in the gallery.

notes.title: Versio 1.0: Achievements and New Art!
notes.content:
Hi!

We’re excited to see you here! The game is finally finished, and we’ve added some exciting updates!

New Features:

[b]Achievements:
[/b][list]
[*] Simply launch the game, and any achievements you earned during the beta will automatically sync with Steam.
[*] New players can enjoy unlocking them all during gameplay!
[/list]

[b]New Art:
[/b][list]
[*] We’ve added stunning new artwork for Harukka and Uka.
[/list]

Enjoy the updated version, and thank you for your support!

notes.title: New Uka Art and Hot Puzzles!
notes.content:
Are you ready to see Uka like never before? We’ve added new character art with 4 sizzling puzzles, where every solved puzzle doesn’t just reveal more of her, but also strips her down!

[list]
[*] Solve the puzzles: Rotate the pieces to gradually undress Uka, piece by piece.
[*] Full revelation: With each completed puzzle, Uka wears less and less until she’s completely naked in front of you.
[/list]

Dive into these steamy challenges and unveil Uka in all her glory!
